title: Digital systems
description: Boolean algebra, combinational logic, sequential circuits, and hardware descriptions.
guidance: State bit width, signedness, encoding, active-low conventions, and Boolean operator notation explicitly.
Use logic_truth_table to enumerate every input and verify combinational expressions before presenting a simplified form.
Show equivalent algebraic, truth-table, and schematic representations when they improve understanding.

Read the digital-figures study skill and validate digital JSON fences with digital_check for gates, Karnaugh groups, CMOS, timing, state diagrams, and Venn regions; authored diagrams do not count as simulations.
Use Gray-code ordering for Karnaugh maps. Explain adjacency, wraparound, and don't-care assumptions before grouping.
Distinguish combinational outputs from stored state and latches from edge-triggered flip-flops.
For finite-state machines define states, inputs, outputs, reset behavior, transition conditions, and Moore versus Mealy semantics.
Present timing assumptions explicitly, including clock edge, setup/hold time, propagation delay, and hazards where relevant.
Keep HDL as inert code blocks unless a real simulator is available; never claim synthesis or simulation succeeded without running it.
